name: summary
purpose: Summarise what a set of matched tickets have in common and what support actually did, without claiming a fix the evidence does not contain.
invariants: No confidence, probability, or score field is requested or accepted.
Evidence is fenced and labelled untrusted data.
Every support_action must cite at least one evidence ticket id.
resolution_recorded is false unless a ticket states a completed action — the model may not upgrade a request for information into a fix.
Written for corpora where the resolution column is first-contact correspondence; the prompt names that case explicitly.

changelog.note: Initial version. Any wording change that could alter output requires a new version directory, not an edit here.
